messages:
Priya (PM): ok team, need a quick decision for Optimize toolkit prioritization. Customers keep asking for quant + batching + caching, but we only have room in the next sprint. wanna do a short RICE-based callout and pick order.
Jamie (Eng): +1. can we treat caching as cheap effort but lower reach?
Lin (ML): quantization wins on cost per token, big impact for embeddings-heavy workloads. but risk: quality regressions and more eval/rollout work. :warning:
Marta (Eng-Infra): batching is infra-heavy (autoscaler hooks, backpressure) but reduces unit cost across the board. medium effort.
Sam (Product Ops): prioritization constraints: 1) must support hosted & dedicated at launch; 2) private deploy can be X-later. customers: BigBank pushing on private quant, StartupX wants batching now.
Alex (Solutions): field note: three customers would pay for quant profiles (Tiered pricing). Batching is often asked by platform teams for throughput bursts.
Priya (PM): propose quick RICE scores, 1-100 scale for Reach/Impact, Effort in engineer-weeks, Confidence %. keep it rough.
Jamie (Eng): quick table in chat:
```
Feature       Reach Impact Effort Confidence RICE
Quant v1      60    40     8      70%        60*40*0.7/8 ~ 210
Batching (basic)50   35     10     60%        ~105
Prefix cache   30    20     4      80%        ~120
KV-share       25    30     6      50%        ~63
```
Lin (ML): numbers ok, but Impact for quant might be higher for embeddings customers (increase reach too). consider two-phase: quant v1 (safe FP16/INT8) then advanced (per-layer + eval harness).
Marta (Eng-Infra): infra constraint: batching needs 2 PRs in runtime and one autoscaler change. timeline ~3 sprints if we do testing matrix. that's the blocker.
Sam (Product Ops): launch criteria proposal: non-regression on core models (quant), 95th percentile latency stay within SLO for batching, and cache eviction correctness for prefix cache.
Priya (PM): my lean plan: 1) Prefix cache (low effort, quick wins) 2) Quant v1 with strict QA + canary 3) Basic batching (place on backlog with infra spike). Thoughts?
Alex (Solutions): sequencing makes sense. Prefix cache will unblock many customers faster.
Jamie (Eng): prefer quant earlier if we can parallelize infra spike with ML work. maybe run quant experiments in parallel with an infra spike week.
Lin (ML): agree. quant profiling + model-level test harness can run in parallel. we can deliver a comms-safe 'optimize:quant' beta.
Marta (Eng-Infra): ok but we need a gating checklist: perf baseline, CPU/GPU memory regressions, canary rollback path, telemetry flags. Without that I won't sign off.
Priya (PM): action items: Sam to draft launch criteria (by EOD), Lin + Jamie estimate parallel work and risks (tomorrow), Marta to list infra blockers and spike cost (tomorrow afternoon). I'll consolidate RICE & final order for roadmap sync.
Sam (Product Ops): on it.
deploy-bot: Reminder: weekly roadmap sync Tues 10am.
Priya (PM): thanks. short follow-up: if one customer offers to fund work (quant on-prem) do we accelerate? quick poll: @Alex @Jamie @Lin react with :thumbsup: to accelerate, :thumbsdown: to keep plan.
Jamie (Eng): :thumbsup:
Lin (ML): :thumbsup:
Alex (Solutions): :thumbsup:
Priya (PM): consensus to accelerate with sponsored work. will coordinate procurement. closing thread — will post consolidated RICE doc and timeline later today. :rocket:
